description: Official technical lane manifest (vendor-neutral, provider-instance-backed): the node reads its providerInstanceRef; the runtime resolves the registered adapter, which computes EMA/RSI/ATR features over the candles it fetches. Deterministic. PRODUCER CONTRACTS (DEM-GOV §9). PLAN: a submitted afi.trade-plan.v1 is verified against the fetched window (levels within one observed-range width; stop/targets opposite sides of entry) and emitted as technical.plan; unverifiable → refusal (D-DEM-5(6)). Absences (D-DEM-5(4)(b)): no plan → no block; no stop or target → no rrToFirstTarget. CANDLE: technical.brokeEmaWithBody (latest body closed counter-trend of EMA20; range: crossed it) and haFlatBack/haFlatBackConfirmed (Heikin-Ashi flat-back, seed (o+c)/2, epsilon 0, agreeing with the lane trend law). HTF: with params.htf set, the declared daily/weekly windows are also fetched and technical.htf.{daily,weekly}.trendBias emitted by the same law; a window under the 50-candle floor emits no sub-block.

candleLimit.description: Number of candles fetched from the price feed for indicator computation.

htf.description: OPTIONAL higher-timeframe selection (DEM-GOV §9 DEM-PRODUCER-HTF, owner determination D-1: an additive optional parameter within the identity of afi-analysis-technical@2.0.0). Absent means the lane fetches only the signal's own timeframe, exactly as before — every existing valid configuration remains valid. Closed vocabularies: the runtime fails closed at boot on anything else.

htfCandleLimit.description: Candles fetched per higher-timeframe window (at or above the 50-candle kernel floor). Default 100.
